quests.title: Fire Up the Grill
quests.intro: Welcome to the Compute Quarter! I only light the grill when an order comes in, so let me show you how serverless functions answer the city's requests.

steps.text: Walk to the Lambda Food Stall and say hello
Learn 5 Lambda cards: triggers, timeouts and pricing
Build the Thumbnail Factory: resize every uploaded photo automatically

steps.prompt: What is a cold start in AWS Lambda and how can I reduce it?
steps.text: Ask the agents about cold starts
Deploy your first serverless API with Cody the Builder

quests.title: Your First Bucket
quests.intro: Every fish in my lake is an object and every net is a bucket. Let's put the city's brochure in a bucket and send it around the world.

steps.text: Walk to S3 Lake and talk to Sally
Learn 5 S3 cards: buckets, durability and storage classes
Learn 3 CloudFront cards about edge caching
Design the City Brochure Site with S3, CloudFront and Route 53
Deploy a private S3 bucket served by CloudFront

quests.title: The Librarian's Card Index
quests.intro: Tell me the exact card number and I'll fetch it in milliseconds. Let me teach you how to pick keys, and how to keep the library open on two continents.

steps.text: Walk to the DynamoDB Library and meet the librarian
Learn 5 DynamoDB cards: keys, capacity modes and indexes
Learn 3 Aurora cards at the Observatory
Keep the booking system running across two Regions
Deploy an on-demand DynamoDB table with point-in-time recovery

quests.title: Market Day Rush
quests.intro: Letters wait patiently in my queue until someone is ready. On market day that patience is what stops the bakery from losing orders!

steps.text: Walk to the Queue & Bell Tower and talk to Quinn
Learn 5 SQS & SNS cards: queues, visibility timeouts and DLQs
Learn 3 API Gateway cards at the station
Design an order pipeline that never drops an order

steps.prompt: When should I use SQS, SNS or EventBridge?
steps.text: Ask the agents to compare the three messengers
Deploy a queue with a dead-letter queue and a Lambda worker

quests.title: The Night Watch
quests.intro: Nobody passes my gate without a badge. Together we'll lock down identities, then set a watch that never sleeps and a wall that holds against the storm.

steps.text: Walk to the IAM Gatehouse and talk to Ivy
Learn 5 IAM cards: roles, least privilege and explicit deny
Learn 3 GuardDuty cards at the Watchtower
Detect threats and respond automatically, even at 3 a.m.
Prepare the ticket shop for a DDoS storm

steps.prompt: What is the difference between CloudWatch and CloudTrail?
steps.text: Ask the agents about monitoring versus auditing

quests.title: Consult the Oracle
quests.intro: Ask me anything, traveller. One API reaches many foundation models, and with a Knowledge Base my answers come from your own documents.

steps.text: Walk to the Bedrock Oracle
Learn 5 Bedrock cards: tokens, RAG and guardrails

steps.prompt: Explain retrieval-augmented generation in two sentences, with an AWS example.
steps.text: Ask the agents what RAG means
Ground an HR assistant in the city's handbook

quests.title: Build an AI Agent
quests.intro: At the Academy every agent gets a runtime, a memory, tools and an identity. Let's enrol your first one and make sure it behaves.

steps.text: Walk to AgentCore Academy and meet Ace
Learn all 8 AgentCore cards: harness, Runtime, Memory, Gateway, Identity and more
Learn 3 Cognito cards so your agent knows who it serves
Assemble the Ask HR Helper agent

steps.prompt: How does AgentCore Gateway turn a Lambda function into a tool my agent can call?
steps.text: Ask the agents how agents get tools

quests.title: Your First Data Lake
quests.intro: I crawl the lake and label every shelf. Once the catalogue is written, Athena can shine her SQL beam right across the water.

steps.text: Walk to the Glue Workshop and talk to Gus
Learn 4 Glue cards: the Data Catalog and crawlers
Learn 4 Athena cards: SQL on S3 and pay-per-scan
Visit the Lake Formation Gate to see who may read what
Query the Lake of Receipts while hiding restricted columns

steps.prompt: Why does converting CSV to partitioned Parquet make Athena cheaper?
steps.text: Ask the agents how to cut query costs
